EC1: COPD exacerbation [OR], very severe COPD [AND] with hypoxemia at low altitude (FEV1/FVC <0.7, FEV1 <40% predicted [OR], oxygen saturation on room air <92% at 750 m).
EC2: Comorbidities such as uncontrolled cardiovascular disease [OR], i.e., unstable systemic arterial hypertension [OR], coronary artery disease [OR]; previous stroke [OR]; OSA [OR]; pneumothorax in the last 2 months.
EC3: Internal [OR], neurologic [OR], rheumatologic [OR] or psychiatric disease including current heavy smoking (>20 cigarettes per day)
EC4: Known renal failure [OR] or allergy to acetazolamide [OR] and other sulfonamides
